decisions.reason: As a large, experienced German software firm, it is likely to view the inbound SMS API as closely related to its existing technical capabilities and, since it remained prominently listed in 2024 after a 2023 launch, to keep refining rather than withdraw it.

The email-to-SMS gateway builds on adjacent messaging and integration knowledge that the firm can readily absorb and improve, so despite being newly launched in 2024 it is more likely to be retained than dropped.

The SMS-to-email gateway is similarly close to the firm's established software and communications know-how, and a large incumbent with absorptive capacity would usually keep such a complementary new offer on the market long enough to learn from early customer use.
